title: PrimeNumberTheoremAnd Blueprint: Open Analytic & L-Series Obligations
description: Six genuine, non-upstreamed open `sorry` theorems copied verbatim from Terence Tao & Alex Kontorovich's PrimeNumberTheoremAnd Blueprint (commit e990613, Apache-2.0): Liouville complete multiplicativity & Dirichlet series, Ramanujan's four-zeta identity (IK 1.28), the alternative ζ(s)^3 divisor identity, and Wiener Fourier decay bounds II & III. Every frozen definition and theorem statement is CI-checked verbatim against upstream.

tasks.title: Liouville function λ(n) = (-1)^Ω(n) is completely multiplicative
Dirichlet series of Liouville function equals ζ(2s)/ζ(s)
tasks.description: Closes `sorry` at `IwaniecKowalskiCh1.lean:1802`: prove `LSeries ↗liouville s = riemannZeta (2 * s) / riemannZeta s` for `Re(s) > 1`.

tasks.title: Ramanujan / IK (1.28) four-zeta Dirichlet series identity
tasks.description: Closes `sorry` at `IwaniecKowalskiCh1.lean:647`: prove `ζ(s) ζ(s-α) ζ(s-β) ζ(s-α-β) = ζ(2s-α-β) L(σ_α · σ_β, s)`.

tasks.title: Alternative Dirichlet series for ζ(s)^3 via τ(m^2)
tasks.description: Closes `sorry` at `IwaniecKowalskiCh1.lean:869`: prove `ζ(s)^3 = L(n ↦ ∑_{d^2 m = n} τ(m^2), s)` for `Re(s) > 1`.
